summary: The bill amends the Agricultural Credit Act of 1978 to let producers receive up to 75% advance payments for emergency farmland rehabilitation or fencing work and up to 75% for forest restoration before starting, to base payments on fair market value, to cover federally caused wildfires that spread naturally, and to require unspent forest funds to be returned after 180 days.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands eligibility and increases advance payment options for two federal programs (ECP and EFRP) that provide financial assistance for natural disaster recovery. This will likely lead to increased federal outlays for these programs.
